title: 有馬記念の後に・『最強』

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon wins the Arima Kinen, and endless tears of joy pour from her once-emotionless eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No one expected her to succeed at long-distance races, but she did her best despite that. Her struggles and achievements have inspired courage in countless people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She will hold that pride in her heart forever. But still, today, too, she sprints off to execute my orders.
